description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to the house, addition of four side flank windows at ground floor level and replacement of first and second floor rear windows with juliet balconies
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 27/04/2022, the proposal as shown on the drawings submitted on 27/04/2022 and numbered 2022-186-001, 2022-186-002, 2022-186-003, 2022-186-004, 2022-186-005, 2022-186-006, 2022-186-007, 2022-186-008, 2022-186-009, 2022-186-010, 2022-186-100, 2022-186-101, 2022-186-102, 2022-186-103, 2022-186-104, 2022-186-105, 2022-186-106, 2022-186-107, 2022-186-108 was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development fails to comply with the terms of Class A.1, Clause F(i) of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) because the proposed single storey rear extension would extended beyond the rear wall by more than 3 metres.
